RP-05 epic residual-gap disposition sweep (Phase 5), across all six code leaves:
- [S2d] Advanced parsers (metrics/config/audit/llm_eval/enrich/certs) still use stock argparse.HelpFormatter → latent py3.13 help-generation regression risk → FILED as db7f-6e32-9df9-40e5 (pinkish-tabarded-cornsnake), linked discovered_from this epic.
- [S2d] Malformed -c/--config prefix fall-through → FIXED in scope (b8de test_malformed_config_prefix_falls_through_to_the_real_cli, mutation-verified).
- [S3] LLM advisory: source-grep guard vs observable → ACCEPTED (guard accompanies observable behavioral tests).
- [S4] s3 push + live-agent boundaries retain existing superset guards → ACCEPTED (registry registers s3_remote/agent_runtime; behavior correct/tested; rewiring is zero-gain risk). Domain-owned unavailable/abstain/fallback modules left unchanged per ticket → ACCEPTED.
- [S5] docs/README.md drift-map wording (ADV1) → FIXED (registry-derived description). rebar-mcp smoke observable (ADV3) → FIXED (asserts exit 0 + 'rebar-mcp' output). Source-grep test advisory → ACCEPTED (paired with observable test_no_curated_census_symbols_remain).
- [S6] Source-grep guard advisory → ACCEPTED (ADV1 sanctions a source guard alongside the observable test_every_intercept_spelling_reaches_the_executor). jira-onboard subprocess E2E dropped → FIXED in scope (covered by registry-derived unit parametrization).
No other enumerated gap outstanding.
